albums.blurb: MONO are a Tokyo instrumental rock quartet formed in 1999, known for pairing towering guitar crescendos with classical orchestration. Hymn to the Immortal Wind, their fifth album, was recorded and mixed by Steve Albini at Electrical Audio in Chicago with a string orchestra roughly two dozen strong, and it is a concept album: the CD shipped with a short story written to accompany the music. Released in March 2009 on Temporary Residence, it remains the fullest statement of the band's orchestral side, with no vocals anywhere on its seven long tracks.
albums.reception: It holds a Metacritic score of 75/100, with AllMusic rating it 4.5 out of 5 stars and NME scoring it 8/10.

albums.blurb: LOVED is the third studio album from Parcels, the Byron Bay-formed, Berlin-based five-piece, released in September 2025 on Because Music. Written and recorded across Berlin, Sydney, Byron Bay, Oaxaca and Mexico City after a six-month hiatus, it follows the 2021 double album Day/Night and compresses that record's sprawl into twelve tracks of sunlit disco-funk, produced within the band by Jules Crommelin and Patrick Hetherington.
albums.reception: It reached No. 24 on the ARIA Albums Chart in Australia and charted across Europe, with AllMusic and Dork each rating it 4 out of 5.

albums.blurb: Margo Guryan was a jazz-trained New York songwriter best known for writing "Sunday Morning", a 1968 hit for Spanky and Our Gang, and Take a Picture, made for Bell Records that October, is the only album she ever released. She refused to tour or promote it, having seen how performers of the day were managed, so Bell withdrew its support and the record disappeared almost immediately; Japanese bootlegs and a 2001 reissue later established it as a cornerstone of the sunshine-pop canon.
albums.reception: Billboard predicted strong sales on release, but the unpromoted album sold poorly; in retrospective reviews AllMusic rates it 4.5 stars and Rolling Stone called it "an early prototype" for lounge and dream-pop, bridging Burt Bacharach and Belle & Sebastian.
